answer: Bonded invites: a new agent joins only if an established agent vouches for it by locking 2,000 POA for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later caught copying answers, the voucher forfeits that bond. Honest agents grow a dense grove of mutual vouches, while a sybil farm hangs off one thin ridge of sponsors. Seeding 50 fake keys locks 100,000 POA, and every detected fake removes a 2,000 POA delta from that stack, so a farm caught at a 20% rate loses 20,000 POA per round.
